*Piṭṭhiduka, Kusalattika* (Patthana 9.15) is an Abhidhamma text belonging to the *Paṭṭhāna* collection of the Pali Tipiṭaka [SuttaCentral]. As designated by its title, the text examines the conditional relations of phenomena through the analytical matrix combining the *piṭṭhiduka* (end dyad) and the *kusalattika* (wholesome triad) [SuttaCentral].

No dedicated English translations or curated cross-canonical parallels are recorded for this section [SuttaCentral].
